actual_request.prompt: Create one new full-body REAR-LEFT THREE QUARTER transparent animation sprite. Image1 is main camera, proportions, identity and costume. Image2 is original identity and image3 approved painting style. Preserve this exact girl, rear-left back view no eyes visible, crown, hair, robe, RIGHT hand star astrolabe, LEFT hand THREE cards. WALK PHASE 05: PASSING pose, very narrow gait under pelvis. Near LEFT leg straight directly below pelvis supports flat grounded. Far RIGHT knee bent gently as it passes beside left knee. BOTH ANKLES ALMOST COINCIDE beneath the pelvis on screen: horizontal separation no greater than 15 pixels on 1024. The far right boot is just 45 pixels raised above the left supporting boot, partly hidden behind its ankle, toe pointing upper-left. Do not draw a wide stride, do not leave the far boot trailing far right, do not place the feet apart to both sides as idle. Draw a slim two-leg silhouette near the center, visibly one grounded support and one raised passing boot. Fixed back-left camera and full equipment. Native 1024 square or greater. Transparent alpha, no ground shadow or matte. Crown y65, support sole y942 proportional to 1024, preserve scale. One independently articulated pose; no mirroring, copying, interpolation or warp. Clean high finish hand-painted Daoist chibi.
